typical_misencoding: Choose an exact local card from an ordinary German action
why_it_happens: The creative articles make one action sound uniquely encoded
deterministic_detection: No LOCAL(exact_card_id) or unique Tier-A realization is present
minimal_repair: Stop at S8_REJECT and obtain the register exemplar; do not invent a synonym card

typical_misencoding: Treat a Tier-B mnemonic such as WARM?, RINSE? or DRAIN? as a portable opcode
why_it_happens: Local Bio prose is mistaken for shared meaning
deterministic_detection: Mnemonic is not one of P01-P04 or lacks an exact licensed local ID
minimal_repair: Keep it as a comment or supply the exact Bio-local card from the copy shelf

typical_misencoding: Write plant, water, body, basin, pipe or station as a card
why_it_happens: A visible silent argument is confused with textual content
deterministic_detection: The noun exists only in BIND_IMAGE_ARG and has no selected exact-card mapping
minimal_repair: Store the visible node handle without output

typical_misencoding: Translate CLOSE as finish, ready or use
why_it_happens: Terminal position is confused with source semantics
deterministic_detection: CLOSE occurs without a terminal-capable exact last card or is assigned a word
minimal_repair: Use CLOSE only as attached commit bit; delete the semantic gloss

typical_misencoding: Add CLOSE to f83r_R4 because the paraphrase sounds complete
why_it_happens: Sentence intuition overrides the selected open-field state
deterministic_detection: CLOSE requested for a field whose exemplar is open
minimal_repair: Execute END_OPEN_FIELD; preserve both open fields

typical_misencoding: End the field, sentence or record at every physical line
why_it_happens: Layout reflow is mistaken for syntax
deterministic_detection: LINE_RESET is followed by loss of owner, active pointer or open field
minimal_repair: Clear renderer-entry state only; preserve all logical state

typical_misencoding: Collapse the two qokaiin copies at f82r.3 to f82r.4
why_it_happens: A repeated boundary card is treated as dittography or an abstract carry symbol
deterministic_detection: Input occurrence count falls from two to one
minimal_repair: Render both exact occurrences and keep carry semantics unresolved

typical_misencoding: Read JOIN or SPACE as a grammatical relation
why_it_happens: Visible separation is made into syntax
deterministic_detection: Edge was selected from meaning rather than copied from the registered surface/layout
minimal_repair: Copy the edge bit; decode it only as JOIN or SPACE

typical_misencoding: Let SET(ARG_AIIN), SET(ARG_AL) or FRAME_O(LINK) choose an arbitrary surface
why_it_happens: A formal operation is mistaken for a one-form word
deterministic_detection: More than one licensed exact realization remains after register and position checks
minimal_repair: Require a canonical registered exemplar or reject; retain the formal operation separately

typical_misencoding: Infer a local whole card from a PAGE_HOST or visible substring
why_it_happens: Surface resemblance is mistaken for a productive lexicon
deterministic_detection: No exact whole-card identity or selected formal construction licenses the mapping
minimal_repair: Use exact card identity only; otherwise LOCAL remains opaque

typical_misencoding: Import Herbal/Bio prompts into an Astro group
why_it_happens: The iatromedical default encourages a shared dictionary
deterministic_detection: State is S7_ASTRO and input is CORE or a prose LOCAL ID
minimal_repair: Use page-local address plus exact Astro groups only

typical_misencoding: Force same-index f68r1 to f69v lookup
deterministic_detection: ASTRO_JOIN transition is requested despite absent visible key and exact match
minimal_repair: Reject the join; retain two separate 28-member namespaces
